executive_summary: Total expenses were INR 380,000.00 above budget, an unfavorable outcome.
The largest explained drivers include India Operations Distribution (INR 180,000.00) and Australia Sales Employee costs (INR 150,000.00).
India | Distribution and Singapore | Employee costs had offsetting lines, with INR 200,000.00 and INR 180,000.00 respectively hidden.
A full-year effect of INR 465,000.00 below plan is expected if recurring items continue at this month's rate.

lines.commentary: India Operations Distribution was INR 240,000.00 above budget, with INR 180,000.00 explained due to urgent air freight for festive-season stock after a supplier delay.
Australia Sales Employee costs were INR 150,000.00 below budget, fully explained by two vacant roles in the Sydney sales team.
Singapore Operations Employee costs were INR 90,000.00 below budget, fully explained by two warehouse supervisors moving to the Singapore Sales cost centre.
India Corporate Consulting was INR 75,000.00 above budget, fully explained by unbudgeted tax advisory support for the GST audit.
Australia Operations Distribution was INR 70,000.00 above budget, with no confirmed explanation; the variance remains unexplained.
India Sales Employee costs were INR 60,000.00 above budget, with no confirmed explanation; the variance remains unexplained.
